authority.pass_authorizes_only: a zero-cell CPU contract; it does not authorize the 248-cell gate until its training artifact and exact hashes are independently verified

graph_and_state_contract.hidden_crosscheck: training response_step h_out versus ONNX h_out max absolute error <= 1e-7 every tick
graph_and_state_contract.normalization: the checkpoint's immutable Stage-1 target_mean/target_std only
graph_and_state_contract.previous_action_chain: previous_action_out must equal calibration_actions bit-exact every tick

heldout_context_gate.actions: the checkpoint's bounded deployable calibrator actions
heldout_context_gate.cells: the existing 16 heldout configurations x 2 hidden plants within the 112 model/plant cells; no additional behavior cells
heldout_context_gate.constant_baseline: predict the frozen Stage-1 training target mean, equivalently zero in normalized target space, on the identical heldout rows
heldout_context_gate.matched_plant_context_rule: for every heldout configuration, start P30 and P31/34 from the same deterministic reset, initial observation, previous action, and h_in with no stochastic sensor perturbation; the deployable calibrator remains authoritative in each closed loop, and final h_out L-infinity separation must exceed 1e-7
heldout_context_gate.normalization: the frozen Stage-1 training normalization only
heldout_context_gate.prediction_metric: mean squared normalized next-response error over all 250 valid transitions using the frozen Stage-1 auxiliary predictor
heldout_context_gate.repeat_rule: repeat every heldout context cell from reset and require all actions, observations, predictions, and h_out values bit-exact
heldout_context_gate.required_prediction_rule: learned aggregate mean MSE must be strictly below the constant baseline separately for P30 and P31/34 at each checkpoint

main_matrix.nominal_sensor_transport_model: load the exact composed scene and apply identity mass scale, zero torso mass/COM change, and the scene's exact nominal torso principal inertia

prerequisites_before_launch: safe ZIP extraction and independent artifact/snapshot/ONNX verification
exact half/final checkpoint and ONNX hashes frozen into a launch contract
one zero-cell CPU contract of this gate implementation in the pinned CPU environment

transport_semantics.action_delay: delay only the action sent to the physical bridge by exactly 1 or 2 ticks; policy previous_action/history remains the graph-authoritative requested action; prehistory is zero

declared_sensor_noise.gravity_and_linvel: declared domain fields have no deployable slot in the frozen calibrator 115-D observation and therefore do not alter another slot
declared_sensor_noise.joint_position: obs[13:27], hip/knee/ankle category scale; head zero
declared_sensor_noise.joint_velocity: obs[27:41], rad/s scale multiplied by frozen 0.05 observation scale

transport_semantics.imu_delay: delay the complete obs[0:6] gyro/accelerometer pair by exactly 1 or 2 ticks; prehistory is zero
transport_semantics.seed_derivation: numpy SeedSequence([120120, 3, checkpoint_index, condition_index, plant_index]); checkpoint order half/final and plant order P30/P31-34
